diagnosis.root_cause: Three tests asserted exact literal substrings in canonical tracked docs (core/E2E_DRAFT_PR_DELIVERY_RULE.md, agents/chatgpt-agent/agent-instructions.md) that had since drifted to different but semantically equivalent wording. Examples: 'After valid approval, the agent may proceed without requesting confirmation' -> 'does not need additional approval for each permitted action'; 'G4 remains a separate human decision' -> 'it is a separate G4 action' (line-wrapped) + 'E2E/G2 does not itself authorize merge'; 'metadata transition from Draft to Ready for review after G3' -> 'Ready-for-review is G3 metadata completion only' + 'This transition is not merge approval'; 'fall back to a known `run_id`' in chatgpt overlay -> 'post-merge lookup cannot prove the target SHA' (the run_id fallback phrase lives in GATE_LIFECYCLE_CONTRACT and DWC instructions; the ChatGPT overlay uses the target-SHA phrasing).
diagnosis.source_of_truth: The tracked docs are canonical; the tests bind literal assertions to them (document-literal contract), so the tests drifted, not the docs. Verified each replacement phrase exists verbatim in the live file before patching.

repair.change: Updated 5 literal assertions across 3 tests to the current canonical doc wording, preserving each test's semantic intent (G2 autonomy boundary no longer blocks post-approval steps; G4/G2 merge boundary; ChatGPT ready-for-review is G3 metadata completion not merge authority; G5 exact post-merge lookup fail-closed CONNECTOR_OBSERVABILITY_INCOMPLETE). No assertion weakened in meaning; every replacement was grep-verified in the live doc.
